description: This file contains unit tests for the ViewList class within the SuiteCRM application. It tests various functionalities such as list view processing, preparation, search form handling, display, and internal state setup of the ViewList component in the MVC architecture.

classes.name: ViewListTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the ViewList component in SuiteCRM, covering methods like listViewProcess, listViewPrepare, processSearchForm, preDisplay, and display.

methods.name: testlistViewProcess
methods.description: Tests the list view processing including database queries and HTML rendering.

methods.name: testViewList
methods.description: Verifies the instantiation and basic properties of the ViewList object.

methods.name: testlistViewPrepare
methods.description: Tests the listViewPrepare method with and without REQUEST parameters, ensuring correct HTML output and REQUEST modifications.

methods.name: testprepareSearchForm
methods.description: Checks the preparation of the search form, both with default and preset request parameters.

methods.name: testprocessSearchForm
methods.description: Validates the processSearchForm method behavior with and without using old search.

methods.name: testpreDisplay
methods.description: Ensures the preDisplay method initializes the lv attribute correctly.

methods.name: testdisplay
methods.description: Tests the display method output with and without bean data, including database setup and cleanup.
